decision_summary: Visionary, Builder, and Guardian approve v0.6.36 Escalation Resolution and Timeliness with operational-evidence-only boundaries.
rationale: The slice closes the unresolved escalation lifecycle gap by extending existing route decisions, while Guardian conditions prevent speed, volume, or disposition from becoming quality, competence, authority, surveillance, or causal claims.
recommendation: Implement and release the narrow calibration-report extension after full fixture and AOF verification.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, accountable reviewers, domain specialists, operators, and affected stakeholders
expected_user_reaction: Users can tell whether an escalation actually resolved, on what evidence, and why governance remains open.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add resolution policy, resolution, assessment, example, verifier, fixtures, plain-language guide, roadmap, and release evidence.
